# fix: bump dashboard - FluffyLabs default + radar comparison fix

## Pull Request by @polykrate

## Summary

Bumps the dashboard submodule to the latest commit (`4a570b3`) which includes:

- **FluffyLabs as default data source** (requested in PR #79 review)
- **Fixed cross-source radar comparison** — uses ratio-based normalization so the compare overlay actually shows visible shape differences
- **Added missing team name aliases** (gossamer, polkajam, strawberry, turbojam)

These changes were pushed after PR #79 was merged, so the deployed version is one commit behind.

## Test plan

- [ ] Dashboard loads with FluffyLabs data by default
- [ ] Radar comparison overlay shows dashed polygons when comparing sources

Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
